content: No, that is not true. While it is true that a termination notice from a landlord can take effect once it is properly served, tenants do have legal rights and remedies to challenge it if it is improper or unlawful. The specific timeline and procedures for challenging a termination notice vary by jurisdiction (local, state, or national laws), but generally, tenants typically have a limited period (e.g., a few days to a few weeks) to respond or file a legal challenge. Failure to act within that period may result in losing the right to contest the termination. It is advisable to consult local tenant protection laws or a legal professional to understand the specific deadlines and procedures in your area.
